_readme: Bank credit-alert parsers, as DATA rather than code, so a shopkeeper can fix
a broken pattern without redeploying and so the community can add a bank
TWO THINGS TO UNDERSTAND BEFORE TRUSTING ANY OF THIS
1. India does not mandate email alerts. RBI/2017-18/15 (6 July 2017) para 5:
'The SMS alerts shall mandatorily be sent to the customers, while email
alerts may be sent, wherever registered.' There is no regulatory floor,
so per-bank behaviour varies wildly and no blanket promise is possible.
2. A DKIM-valid 'credited' email is NOT proof that money settled. RBL Bank
was documented (Moneylife, 1 July 2026) firing 'Account Credited' e-alerts
where 47 of 54 corresponded to no credit in the statement — the bank
confirmed they fire on declined transactions and internal reversals.
Authenticating the sender proves the bank sent it. It does not prove the
bank was right. That is why `trust` exists below.

autoConfirm.//: Auto-dispatch happens only when the bank is `verified` AND the order
autoConfirm.//2: is at or below this ceiling. A false positive should cost one item,
autoConfirm.//3: not a bulk order. Shopkeepers can raise it once they trust it.

forwardCopyTo.//: Several banks (HDFC confirmed) have no alerts-only address — changing
forwardCopyTo.//2: the alert email changes the PRIMARY email across every relationship,
forwardCopyTo.//3: so statements and service notices land here too. The Email Worker
forwardCopyTo.//4: forwards a copy onward so the account holder keeps their visibility.

trustLevels.verified: UPI credit emails confirmed from a primary source, with no minimum-amount threshold. May auto-confirm.
trustLevels.unverified: Email channel exists but UPI-credit behaviour is unconfirmed. Requires a passing self-test; never auto-confirms until an admin has confirmed one alert manually.
trustLevels.unsuitable: Known not to work for this design — no email on UPI credit, or a threshold above typical order values.
trustLevels.unreliable: Sends credit emails that do not reliably correspond to settled money. Never auto-confirms, at any amount.

banks.name: HDFC Bank
notes: The only bank confirmed to high confidence. When HDFC imposed SMS
thresholds from 25 June 2024 (no SMS for UPI sent <= Rs 100 or received
< Rs 500) it explicitly continued EMAIL for ALL UPI transactions. A user
on the same announcement thread reports email arriving for a Rs 10 UPI
payment, i.e. no email threshold. Email alerts are free; only SMS
InstaAlerts are charged.
TWO SENDER DOMAINS ARE LIVE CONCURRENTLY. Indian banks migrated to the
RBI-designated bank.in domains during 2025, so alerts@hdfcbank.net and
alerts@hdfcbank.bank.in are both observed. Match on the DKIM d= value,
never on the From header.
NO ALERTS-ONLY ADDRESS. Updating the alert email updates the PRIMARY
email across every HDFC relationship. Forwarding a copy onward is not
optional for this bank.
Configure: NetBanking > InstaAlerts > select account > alert types.
The verified sample is a DEBIT alert. Credit wording is assumed
symmetric and MUST be confirmed by the setup self-test before use.

banks.name: ICICI Bank
notes: ICICI's own alerts page scopes EMAIL alerts to NRI customers. Resident
savings customers are offered SMS, with a user-set credit threshold that
defaults to Rs 5,000 — far above a typical small-shop order.
Not usable for automatic verification. Use manual mode, or bank elsewhere.

banks.name: State Bank of India
notes: The product is branded 'SMS Alert' and carries a Rs 5,000 minimum credit
threshold. Multiple user reports say SBI does not fire credit alerts for
inward UPI at all unless the payer used an @sbi / @oksbi handle.
Not usable for automatic verification.

banks.name: RBL Bank
notes: DO NOT AUTO-CONFIRM ON THIS BANK AT ANY AMOUNT.
RBL sends DKIM-signed 'E-alert from RBL Bank Account Credited' emails
carrying amount, reference number and balance. Moneylife documented
(1 July 2026) a case where 47 of 54 such emails corresponded to NO credit
in the statement; the bank confirmed they fire for declined transactions
and internal reversals.
This is the reason trust tiers exist. Sender authentication proves the
bank sent the mail. It does not prove the bank was correct.

banks.name: IndusInd Bank
notes: IndusInd's own current-account form offers email for daily and monthly
e-statements only, not per-transaction alerts.

banks.name: Kotak Mahindra Bank
notes: Email channel exists; UPI-credit behaviour and thresholds unconfirmed. Self-test required.

banks.name: Axis Bank
notes: Email channel exists; UPI-credit behaviour and thresholds unconfirmed. Self-test required.

banks.name: Generic fallback
notes: Never auto-confirms. Writes the credit as low-confidence and asks the
admin to confirm the first alert from a given sender, then offers to
save the learned pattern as a new bank entry.
